verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const need=["lib/billing/tips.ts","lib/commerce/checkout.ts","lib/billing/tickets.ts"];for(const f of need){if(!fs.existsSync(f)){console.error("SCAN-764: "+f+" missing");process.exit(79)}}const seg=(s,start)=>{const i=s.indexOf(start);if(i<0)return null;const r=s.slice(i);const j=r.indexOf("\nexport ",10);return j>0?r.slice(0,j):r};const tips=seg(fs.readFileSync(need[0],"utf8"),"export async function recordTipFromSession(");const ord=seg(fs.readFileSync(need[1],"utf8"),"export async function recordCommerceOrderFromSession(");const tk=fs.readFileSync(need[2],"utf8");const fi=tk.indexOf("function flippedRows(");if(!tips||!ord||fi<0){console.error("SCAN-764: a settle recorder was not found");process.exit(79)}const fr=tk.slice(fi,tk.indexOf("return (result.data",fi));const okUpdate=(x)=>/\{\s*data:\s*updated\s*,\s*error(?::\s*\w+)?\s*\}\s*=\s*await\s+db\(\)/.test(x)&&/if\s*\(\s*\w*[eE]rror\s*\)\s*\{?\s*throw/.test(x);const bad=[];if(!okUpdate(tips))bad.push("recordTipFromSession (tips)");if(!okUpdate(ord))bad.push("recordCommerceOrderFromSession (commerce_orders)");if(!/\bthrow\b/.test(fr)||/return\s*\[\s*\]/.test(fr))bad.push("flippedRows (tickets)");if(bad.length){console.error("SCAN-764: "+bad.join(", ")+" still swallow(s) the DB error on the paid flip, so a failed settle is acked 200 with the Stripe claim kept and the tip, order or ticket stays pending forever with no redelivery.");process.exit(1)}'

append.detail: Three of the four recorders behind recordPaidCheckout swallowed the DB error on the paid flip: recordTipFromSession never read error from the update, recordCommerceOrderFromSession did the same until SCAN-710 landed its throw on main, and flippedRows in tickets logged the RPC error and returned [], so a transient failure looked like a redelivery, the Stripe route acked 200 with the claim kept, and the tip, order or ticket stayed pending forever with no redelivery. Each settle write now throws (tips captures { data: updated, error } and throws, commerce_orders already did via SCAN-710; flippedRows throws after its console.error, so the ticket refund path redelivers too). The on-page backstops already caught (settleTipAction, settleTicketAction, settleCommerceOrderAction, the Journey welcome page); the two that did not (people/[handle]/page.tsx and events/[slug]/event-member-page.tsx) and the inline reconcile in refundTicket (Stripe refund already made) now catch and log so a paying buyer never sees an error page. Pinned in lib/billing/tips.test.ts, lib/commerce/checkout.test.ts and lib/billing/tickets-settle.test.ts (the two tests that asserted never-throws were flipped to assert the throw and that no downstream side effect runs).
